title: Implement Across API service and quote fetching
description:
Implement the core API integration — fetching quotes from the Across Swap API.

Files to create:
- packages/swapper/src/swappers/AcrossSwapper/utils/acrossService.ts
- packages/swapper/src/swappers/AcrossSwapper/utils/fetchAcrossTrade.ts
- packages/swapper/src/swappers/AcrossSwapper/utils/getTrade.ts

acrossService.ts:
- Axios instance pointing to VITE_ACROSS_API_URL
- NO cache (Across explicitly prohibits caching /swap/approval responses)
- Reasonable timeout (~10s like Relay)

fetchAcrossTrade.ts:
- GET /swap/approval with query params:
  tradeType: 'exactInput', amount, inputToken, outputToken, originChainId, destinationChainId,
  depositor, recipient (for cross-account), appFee (affiliateBps / 10000), appFeeRecipient (per-chain treasury),
  integratorId (from env), slippage ('auto' or user value)
- For appFeeRecipient: use getTreasuryAddressFromChainId(buyAsset.chainId), gracefully skip if no treasury for chain (Monad/HyperEVM/Plasma)
- Return typed AcrossSwapApprovalResponse

getTrade.ts (core logic, ~400 lines):
- Map our internal types → Across API params → our TradeQuote type
- Handle the ecosystem discriminator: swapTx.ecosystem 'evm' vs 'svm'
- For EVM: extract calldata, gas, allowanceContract from checks.allowance.spender
- For Solana (svm): base64 swapTx.data needs to be deserialized into TransactionInstructions
  to feed into existing solanaTransactionMetadata pattern (like Jupiter/Relay)
  Use VersionedTransaction.deserialize(Buffer.from(data, 'base64'))
- Map Across fees → our protocol fees (bridge fees are protocol fees to user)
- Map Across app fees → our affiliate fees
- Map expectedFillTime → estimatedExecutionTimeMs
- Handle errors: map Across error codes to TradeQuoteError enum
- Cross-chain only (Across doesn't support same-chain swaps — confirmed via curl)
- Use filterCrossChainEvmBuyAssetsBySellAssetId for route filtering + add Solana support

Acceptance criteria:
- Quotes return for EVM↔EVM cross-chain pairs
- Quotes return for EVM→Solana and Solana→EVM
- Affiliate fees correctly included for chains with treasury addresses
- No affiliate fees for chains without treasury (no error, just omit appFee)
- Errors mapped correctly to TradeQuoteError
close_reason: Created acrossService.ts (no-cache axios instance), fetchAcrossTrade.ts (GET /swap/approval with URLSearchParams), and getTrade.ts (core quote/rate logic with chain validation, fee calculation, error mapping). Also added VITE_ACROSS_API_URL and VITE_ACROSS_INTEGRATOR_ID to SwapperConfig, acrossTransactionMetadata to TradeQuoteStep/SwapperSpecificMetadata. Type-check and lint clean.

title: Implement Across swapper endpoints (quote, rate, status)
description:
Wire up the SwapperApi endpoints and the Swapper execution layer.

Files to create:
- packages/swapper/src/swappers/AcrossSwapper/endpoints.ts
- packages/swapper/src/swappers/AcrossSwapper/getTradeQuote/getTradeQuote.ts
- packages/swapper/src/swappers/AcrossSwapper/getTradeRate/getTradeRate.ts
- packages/swapper/src/swappers/AcrossSwapper/AcrossSwapper.ts

getTradeQuote.ts / getTradeRate.ts:
- Thin wrappers around getTrade.ts (same as Relay pattern)
- Quote requires receiveAddress + sendAddress + accountNumber
- Rate is lighter (uses dummy addresses for non-binding quotes)

endpoints.ts — SwapperApi implementation:
- getTradeQuote: calls getTradeQuote.ts
- getTradeRate: calls getTradeRate.ts
- checkTradeStatus: polls GET /deposit/status?depositTxnRef={txHash}
  - Map status values:
    'filled' → { status: TxStatus.Confirmed, buyTxHash: fillTxnRef }
    'pending' → { status: TxStatus.Pending, message: 'Deposit detected, processing...' }
    'slowFillRequested' → { status: TxStatus.Pending, message: 'Taking longer than usual...' }
    'expired' → { status: TxStatus.Failed, message: 'Deposit expired' }
    'refunded' → { status: TxStatus.Failed, message: 'Deposit refunded on origin chain' }
  - For cross-chain: buyTxHash comes from fillTxnRef in status response
  - For EVM→Solana: user signs EVM tx, buyTxHash is on Solana (from fillTxnRef)

AcrossSwapper.ts — Swapper execution:
- executeEvmTransaction: sign the swapTx calldata (standard EVM pattern)
- executeSolanaTransaction: for Solana→EVM, sign the deserialized Solana transaction
  Follow the shared executeSolanaTransaction pattern from utils.ts
- getUnsignedEvmTransaction / getUnsignedSolanaTransaction: extract from quote metadata

Acceptance criteria:
- getTradeQuote returns valid quotes for supported cross-chain pairs
- getTradeRate returns valid rates
- checkTradeStatus correctly maps all 5 Across statuses
- EVM execution works (sign returned calldata)
- Solana execution works (sign deserialized base64 tx)
- Swapper registered in packages/swapper/src/constants.ts with endpoints + swapper
close_reason: Created endpoints.ts (SwapperApi with getTradeQuote, getTradeRate, EVM execution, checkTradeStatus with all 5 Across status mappings), AcrossSwapper.ts (EVM execution), getTradeQuote.ts and getTradeRate.ts (thin wrappers). Registered swapper in constants.ts. Fixed public-api config and useTradeButtonProps for new metadata fields. Type-check and lint clean across entire codebase.

description: Deep dive into architecture and performance implications of BigAmount migration: selector memoization behavior with BigAmount objects, Redux serialization considerations, BigAmount object allocation in hot paths, potential memory concerns from BigAmount vs string storage in state.

HIGH: Redundant createDeepEqualOutputSelector for single BigAmount results. MEDIUM: No custom BigAmount serialization for persistence. Root cause: string storage in Redux.
